brief:
The piece describes nightly gatherings of roughly 30 people, including children, in an empty space outside a displacement shelter where the writer was housed. These protests took place at 9 p.m. during the early weeks of the conflict in Gaza, according to Middle East Eye.

The author argues that such demonstrations must persist alongside broader opposition to the fighting. The account emphasizes the role of displaced Palestinians in maintaining visible dissent against the military operations.

title: Gaza protesters maintain nightly vigils as conflict continues
